b.label: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

edges.label: ODNI headquarters at Liberty Crossing
edges.note: The Liberty Crossing intelligence campus, which houses ODNI alongside the National Counterterrorism Center, is in McLean, Virginia: an official federal record titles the President's 27 July 2021 remarks there 'Remarks at the Liberty Crossing Intelligence Campus and an Exchange With Reporters in McClean, Virginia' - the misspelling is the record's own. That record fixes where the campus is; it does not itself designate ODNI's headquarters, which is why this is tier 2.
